tools.name: list_available_tickers
tools.description: Returns ticker symbols for companies with published RentSeek executive-compensation data. Compensation values, evidence lookup, historical data, and purchasing are outside this tool's scope. The result contains availability only, not investment advice.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_executive_compensation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
